notes: Deterministic lint policy for the brain layer. Encodes the four writing rules from CLAUDE.md plus the source:/expires: provenance convention so they are enforced by `node _os/automation/bin/wiki-lint.js` instead of relying on an agent to remember them. Severity `error` fails the run; `warn` reports only.

vault_scan.notes: Folders excluded from the link graph entirely. Site builds and dependencies are code, not vault pages.

untracked_by_design.notes: Prefixes that are gitignored on purpose. A wikilink into these resolves on the operator's Obsidian desktop but can never resolve in Git, so it is reported as `private` rather than broken. Keep this list in sync with .gitignore.

rules.description: Every compiled brain page opens with a YAML frontmatter fence.
CLAUDE.md: every compiled page carries a source: link back to the raw capture or vault note it came from. A page without a source gets flagged, not trusted.
CLAUDE.md: research findings carry a date and an expires: date so stale knowledge announces itself.
Pages whose expires: date has passed are stale and need a re-verification pass.
Every [[wikilink]] resolves to a real note or to a path that is gitignored by design. Prose that mentions link syntax belongs in backticks so Obsidian stops rendering it as a red broken link.
rules.exclude_reason: raw/ is verbatim read-only history (writing rule 4) — its links are whatever the capture said and are never edited to satisfy a linter.

rules.description: CLAUDE.md reading rule 1: agents start at INDEX.md and walk the links. A brain page no trail reaches is invisible, so new/removed pages must update INDEX.md in the same change.
12_Brain/ is the only second-brain tree. A competing 1Z_Brain/ splits the graph.
